families.title: Hydraulic & Sluice Engineering
families.summary: Water and elemental hazard trenches bridged by sequential boulders, ice blocks, and compacted dirt.
families.summaryFr: Tranchées d'eau et de dangers élémentaires comblées par des rochers séquentiels, des blocs de glace et de la terre compactée.

families.title: Counterweights & Alcove Extraction
families.summary: Pressure-plate hold gates, counterweight swaps, and recessed boulders extracted with grappling gloves.
families.summaryFr: Portes maintenues par dalles de pression, échanges de contrepoids et rochers encastrés extraits au grappin.

families.title: Prismatic Optics
families.summary: Laser emitters routed around pillars and across shared chambers through movable diagonal mirrors.
families.summaryFr: Émetteurs laser déviés autour de piliers et à travers des salles partagées via des miroirs diagonaux mobiles.

families.title: Kinetic & Cryo Routing
families.summary: Frictionless ice slides, corner deflectors, conveyor currents, and block cloner foundries.
families.summaryFr: Glissades sur glace sans friction, déflecteurs d'angle, courants convoyeurs et fonderies de clonage.

families.title: Network & Logic Sanctuaries
families.summary: Multi-island teleport ferries and dual-chamber boolean signal relays.
families.summaryFr: Transbordeurs de téléportation multi-îles et relais logiques booléens à double chambre.

archetypes.title: Single-Boulder Sluice
archetypes.summary: Bridge a one-tile water channel by pushing a stone boulder into the trench and compacting the resulting dirt.
archetypes.summaryFr: Comblez un canal d'eau d'une case en poussant un rocher dans la tranchée puis en compactant la terre obtenue.
invariants: Keep at least one walkable floor cell behind the boulder on its push axis so the player can align with the trench.
Always place a socket or closed gate before the exit when a block exists on the map to prevent socket_bypass warnings.
Stepping onto the resulting dirt tile compacts it into standard floor.
deadEndTraps: Pushing the boulder sideways against a boundary wall locks it unless grappling gloves are available.
Placing a collectible chip on a cell the boulder can reach triggers a hidden_by_block validator warning.

archetypes.title: Sequential Double-Trench Sluice
archetypes.summary: Bridge a two-tile water trench with two boulders, compacting the first dirt bridge tile before pushing the second boulder across.
archetypes.summaryFr: Comblez une tranchée d'eau de deux cases avec deux rochers en compactant la première motte de terre avant d'y pousser le second rocher.
invariants: A dirt_block sinking into water creates a dirt tile, which blocks subsequent entities until the player steps on it.
The player must step onto the first bridged cell and return to the staging room before pushing the second boulder.
Provide a loop or wide staging room so the second boulder can be routed into the same column.
deadEndTraps: Attempting to push the second boulder into the first before compacting the dirt leaves the second boulder blocking the choke point.
Pushing the second boulder into a top or side wall wastes the only remaining bridge.

archetypes.title: Elemental Fire-to-Water Sluice
archetypes.summary: Push an ice block into a fire barrier to transmute it into water, then bridge the water with a stone boulder.
archetypes.summaryFr: Poussez un bloc de glace dans un brasier pour le transmuter en eau, puis comblez l'eau avec un rocher.
invariants: An ice_block pushed into fire melts both the block and the fire into a water tile.
A dirt_block pushed into raw fire stops or fails to bridge; the ice_block must always enter first.
Stage the ice_block closer to the fire choke or in a parallel lane so both blocks can be sequenced cleanly.
deadEndTraps: Pushing the dirt_block into the choke corridor before the ice_block seals the lane in front of the fire.
Pushing the ice_block against a wall instead of down the choke leaves the fire barrier unquenched.

archetypes.title: Counterweight Hold-Plate
archetypes.summary: Park a stone boulder on a colour-coded pressure plate to keep a linked hold door open.
archetypes.summaryFr: Stationnez un rocher sur une dalle de pression colorée pour maintenir ouverte la porte associée.
invariants: A hold_door_<color>_closed tile opens only while every pressure_plate_<color> of the same colour on the map is pressed.
Place the pressure plate at the end of a push lane or with a wall backstop so the boulder stops squarely on the plate.
Never start a hold door in the open state unless all plates of its colour start pressed.
deadEndTraps: Overshooting the pressure plate into a corner when no backstop wall is present.
Pushing the counterweight boulder into water instead of onto the plate when both exist in the same room.

archetypes.title: Recessed Alcove Extraction
archetypes.summary: Use grappling gloves to pull a boulder out of a three-walled recess, then step perpendicularly to release it before pushing.
archetypes.summaryFr: Utilisez les gants grappin pour extraire un rocher d'une alcôve à trois murs, puis décalez-vous perpendiculairement avant de le pousser.
invariants: With boots_pull equipped, stepping away from an adjacent block pulls that block into the player's previous cell.
Always provide a perpendicular side cell at the end of a pull corridor so the player can step sideways without re-pulling the block.
Keep collectible items inside a 3-walled alcove or behind a dirt tile so pulled blocks cannot cover them.
deadEndTraps: Walking straight back down a 1-tile corridor with boots_pull drags the block behind the player all the way back.
Forgetting to leave a perpendicular release cell makes it impossible to get behind the extracted block.

archetypes.title: Counterweight Bridge Swap
archetypes.summary: Spend a first boulder to bridge a water moat, then extract a recessed second boulder with grappling gloves to weight the hold plate.
archetypes.summaryFr: Utilisez un premier rocher pour franchir les douves, puis extrayez un second rocher encastré avec le grappin pour lester la dalle.
invariants: Separate the upper boulder from the grappling gloves with a dirt tile so the upper boulder cannot cover the gloves.
The water moat forces the first boulder to be consumed as a bridge, proving the recessed second boulder is required for the plate.
Provide a 2-row release pocket on the far side of the lower corridor so the player can step North and get behind the pulled boulder.
deadEndTraps: Bridging the water before picking up the grappling gloves in the upper chamber requires backtracking.
Pulling the lower boulder all the way against the East wall leaves no room to push it onto the plate.

archetypes.title: Multi-Prism Beam Slalom
archetypes.summary: Route a laser beam around a stone pillar using two movable diagonal mirrors to illuminate a receiver and open its laser gate.
archetypes.summaryFr: Déviez un faisceau laser autour d'un pilier de pierre à l'aide de deux miroirs diagonaux mobiles pour illuminer un récepteur et ouvrir sa grille.
invariants: Place a solid wall backstop behind the first mirror's target cell so the unreflected beam never cuts the player's exit route.
Stage movable mirrors one cell outside the active beam line so the player pushes them into the beam without stepping onto a live beam cell.
Shield the exit corridor with a dirt tile so mirrors cannot be pushed onto the chip or socket.
deadEndTraps: Stepping onto an active laser beam cell after pushing a mirror along the beam axis is fatal.
Pushing the upper mirror before positioning the lower mirror cuts the room with the vertical deflected beam.

archetypes.title: Recessed Alcove Prism
archetypes.summary: Extract a diagonal mirror from a three-walled recess using grappling gloves, release it via a side step, and push it into a laser beam.
archetypes.summaryFr: Extrayez un miroir diagonal d'une alcôve à trois murs avec le grappin, dégagez-vous par un pas de côté, puis poussez-le dans le faisceau laser.
invariants: Confine the live unreflected laser beam to a 1-tile pocket against a wall so the player never crosses the beam while pulling the mirror.
Pull the mirror out of the alcove to a safe staging cell, step North into the release pocket, then push the mirror East into the beam.
Protect the exit corridor and the grappling gloves alcove with dirt tiles so the mirror cannot cover collectibles.
deadEndTraps: Pulling the mirror directly onto the active beam cell kills the player on the pull step.
Pulling the mirror without stepping into the North release pocket drags the mirror back toward the alcove.

archetypes.title: Crossed Dual-Beam Matrix
archetypes.summary: Route two orthogonal laser beams across a shared chamber into red and blue receivers to unlock a dual-stage laser gate vault.
archetypes.summaryFr: Acheminez deux faisceaux laser orthogonaux à travers une salle commune vers des récepteurs rouge et bleu pour déverrouiller un double sas laser.
invariants: Stage both mirrors one cell North of their beam rows so pushing them South into the beams keeps the player in the safe upper lane.
Two laser beams may cross orthogonally on an open floor cell without interfering with each other.
Chain laser_gate_red_closed and laser_gate_blue_closed in series so both receivers must remain lit simultaneously.
deadEndTraps: Walking South into an active horizontal beam instead of staying in the upper staging lane is fatal.
Pushing a mirror through the upper beam into the lower beam without leaving the second mirror on the upper beam starves the red receiver.

archetypes.title: Glacier Slide & Corner Deflector
archetypes.titleFr: Glissade sur glacier et déflecteur d'angle
archetypes.summary: Launch a stone boulder across frictionless ice into a curved corner wall so it slides onto a distant pressure plate.
archetypes.summaryFr: Lancez un rocher sur de la glace sans friction vers un mur d'angle incurvé afin qu'il glisse jusque sur une dalle de pression distante.
invariants: A block pushed onto ice slides until it hits a non-ice tile, a wall, or a corner deflector.
Use ice_ne (deflects E to S and N to W) at the top-right corner of the slide lane so an East-pushed block turns South onto the plate.
Place a wall immediately South of the target pressure plate so the sliding block stops on the plate and cannot enter the lower chamber.
deadEndTraps: Pushing the boulder South instead of East into the ice strip misses the corner deflector.
Stepping onto the ice strip without ice cleats slides the player onto the plate without the boulder.

archetypes.title: Current Sluice Conveyor
archetypes.summary: Push a boulder onto a one-way force current so the stream carries it into a distant water sluice or hold plate.
archetypes.summaryFr: Poussez un rocher sur un courant directionnel afin que le flux l'emporte vers une écluse ou une dalle distante.
invariants: A block pushed onto a force floor slides automatically in the force direction on each tick until it reaches a normal tile.
Terminate the force belt directly on a pressure plate or water trench with a wall behind it so the block settles cleanly.
Keep the player's approach perpendicular to the belt entry so the player never steps onto the one-way current.
deadEndTraps: Pushing the boulder South past the belt entry row leaves it below the conveyor stream.
Entering the conveyor without suction boots traps the player in the one-way pocket.

archetypes.title: Block Cloner Foundry
archetypes.summary: Trigger a red clone button to stamp stone boulders from a clone machine and bridge a multi-tile water channel.
archetypes.summaryFr: Actionnez un bouton de clonage rouge pour produire des rochers depuis une machine de clonage et combler un canal d'eau.
invariants: Every clone_machine needs both an explicit cloneLink from a button_red and a template entity placed on the machine cell.
Orient the template entity so it spawns into an open push lane where the player can get behind the spawned block.
After pushing the first cloned block into water, compact the resulting dirt before spawning and pushing a second block.
deadEndTraps: Placing the clone machine directly behind the spawn cell with no room for the player prevents pushing along the spawn axis.
Pressing the red button while the spawn cell ahead of the clone machine is still occupied produces no block.

archetypes.title: Multi-Island Teleport Ferry
archetypes.summary: Push a boulder through a colour-coded teleport ring to a disconnected island so it lands on a hold plate, then follow through a second portal.
archetypes.summaryFr: Poussez un rocher à travers un anneau téléporteur coloré vers une île isolée afin qu'il atterrisse sur une dalle, puis suivez par un second portail.
invariants: Every teleport group on a level must have at least two teleporters of the same colour to avoid teleport_alone warnings.
An entity or player entering a teleporter in direction D exits the destination teleporter one tile in direction D.
Seal unused sides of the player's arrival teleporter with walls so a closed hold door on the exit side cannot be bypassed via fallback directions.
deadEndTraps: Leaving open floor adjacent to the arrival teleporter lets the teleporter sidestep a closed door on its primary exit side.
Stepping into the boulder's teleport ring before pushing the boulder strands the player on the lower island.

archetypes.title: Dual-Chamber Signal Relay
archetypes.summary: Charge both a signal pressure plate and a laser receiver wired through an AND logic gate to unlock a central vault hold door.
archetypes.summaryFr: Alimentez simultanément une dalle de signal et un récepteur laser câblés sur une porte logique ET pour ouvrir la porte du sanctuaire central.
invariants: A signal_gate_and requires two incoming signalLinks from valid sources (signal_plate or laser_receiver_*) and one outgoing link to a sink (hold_door_*_closed).
When a hold_door_<color>_closed is driven by a signal link, it ignores standalone pressure plates and opens only when its signal source is high.
Stage the mirror one cell North of the emitter beam so pushing it South into the beam keeps the player in the safe upper lane.
deadEndTraps: Leaving a signal source or logic gate with missing incoming or outgoing links triggers signal wiring validator warnings.
Pushing the boulder past the signal plate or missing the mirror column leaves one input of the AND gate low.
